question: Find the product: 1.2 × 2 (2)/(5) × (3)/(4)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Convert the fractions into decimals for faster and easier multiplication. ⇒ 2 ²/₅ = 2.4 ⇒ ³/₄ = 0.75 ⇒ Product = 1.2 × 2.4 × 0.75 ⇒ Rearranging for ease: (1.2 × 0.75) × 2.4 = 0.9 × 2.4 = 2.16 **∴ The correct answer is 2.16.**
